document.abstract: To ensure that the new form of interactive programs is fully functional as we enter the era of digital broadcasting, NHK has prepared an array of equipment for such programs in its HDTV and SDTV studios. This equipment centers around a video file system that uses a video server and is used with a fast network that employs IP over ATM.
